title: 643. Find Duplicate File in System

examples.explanation: Files holding abcd form one group; files holding efgh form another.
Each content value appears twice, so two groups are reported.
A single file has no partner, so nothing is reported.

hints: Split each entry on spaces: the first token is the folder, later tokens look like name(content).
Key a hash map by the content text and push dir + '/' + name into that bucket.
Return only buckets holding two or more paths; lone files are not duplicates.
Adaptation: the input list maps to string_array and the grouped output maps to string_list_2d in this judge.
